events.description: A cliff of {tokens[0]} tokens was unlocked from Liquid TOPAZ on {timestamp}

notes: "Protocol Foundation & Team" and "Airdrop & Sacrifice" are distributed as veTOPAZ. These sections are marked TBD as unlock depends on individual lock expiry.

insiders.methodology: Tracks the team wallet receiving 5% of weekly emissions from the Minter. Received is a running total of an ongoing emission, not a fixed allocation. Staked tracks TOPAZ locked into veTOPAZ.

Protocol Foundation & Team.methodology: 250M TOPAZ locked as veTOPAZ with a 4-year lock at launch for protocol governance, strategic voting, and long-term alignment.

foundation-team.name: Protocol Foundation & Team
foundation-team.methodology: 250M TOPAZ allocated as veTOPAZ, locked for 4 years with no fixed release schedule; unlock depends on individual lock expiry.

Airdrop & Sacrifice.methodology: 200M TOPAZ distributed as locked veTOPAZ to sacrifice participants and airdrop recipients at launch, giving early supporters governance power from day one.

airdrop-sacrifice.name: Airdrop & Sacrifice
airdrop-sacrifice.methodology: 200M TOPAZ distributed as locked veTOPAZ; unlock depends on individual lock expiry.

Gauge Emissions.methodology: Tracks TOPAZ distributed from the Minter to the Voter contract each epoch for LP gauge rewards.

gauge-rewards.name: Gauge Emissions
gauge-rewards.methodology: TOPAZ transferred from Minter to Voter contract, tracked via Transfer events on BSC.

Rebase Emissions.methodology: Tracks TOPAZ distributed from the Minter to the RewardsDistributor for veTOPAZ rebase, reducing vote power dilution for lockers.

vetopaz-rebase.name: Rebase Emissions
vetopaz-rebase.methodology: TOPAZ transferred from Minter to RewardsDistributor, tracked via Transfer events on BSC.

Team Emissions.methodology: 5% of weekly emissions minted to the team address from the Minter contract.

team-emissions.name: Team Emissions
team-emissions.methodology: TOPAZ transferred from Minter to team address, tracked via Transfer events on BSC.
